document.summary: A Cloudflare Turnstile finding that can improve the experience for users in mainland China.

sections.title: Abstract
sections.content: This document outlines a finding in Cloudflare Turnstile that can improve the experience for users in mainland China.

sections.title: How did I find this
sections.content: I was playing around with [crt.name](https://crt.name), searching for half-public services, when I stumbled upon a subdomain called `challenges.cloudflare-cn.com`. The page it serves is identical to `challenges.cloudflare.com`, so it appears to be a mirror. Interestingly, the global Turnstile script endpoint is `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js`.

sections.title: Testing the finding
sections.content: I created an HTML document embedding a Cloudflare verification widget using a testing key, following the official [Cloudflare documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/client-side-rendering/). It worked. Then I added `-cn` to the Cloudflare domain — it worked perfectly and was noticeably faster on a native China network. Using `cdn-cgi/trace`, I confirmed that this endpoint always routes through [Cloudflare datacenters in China](https://www.cloudflare.com/products/china-network/), which are normally inaccessible to non-enterprise customers. This Turnstile endpoint works fine, though, so it's perfect.

sections.title: Integrating it into an actual product
sections.content: Around that time, some users of [Prism](https://prism.siiway.org) were experiencing issues where they could not use the Turnstile login captcha. We tried working around this with locally hosted PoW, but it did not work very well. I applied this new finding — which, I proudly say, is the only product I've seen do this — to Prism in [this commit](https://github.com/siiway/prism/pull/14/changes/4b6f62aa9e8798bc553740e0e82a46f2fa00628d). It works pretty well and I'm happy with the result. Then I struggled to change the configuration on the [public instance](https://prism.siiway.org), but that's another story.

sections.title: Quick how to use
sections.content: Detect the user's location and switch between the endpoints `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js` and `https://challenges.cloudflare-cn.com/turnstile/v0/api.js`. The server-side verification API endpoint remains unchanged.
